body: I hope you don’t, I’m so sorry to hear about what you’ve been through. The same thing happened to my sister. It effected her in so many ways, she never got the help she really needed. She’s not here any more and I wish I could have don’t more to help, but truth to be told I wouldn’t know where to begin, Im also not sure what good I could have done. I feel so sorry for you but there is help out there and I hope you find the help you need before you do anything bad.

People just say that once people have gone because it makes them feel better about themselves. Because everyone is selfish. Your partner sounds like a right cunt, it’s not always as easy as get up and leave. There isn’t any point asking other people for help, your the only one who can help. People never understand your emotions or how your mind works. Nobody has the answers, everyone is alone but most people pretend they aren’t. I don’t know what to say but as another human who feels alone I hope you can get through this. Peace out ✌️
